title: Better Late Than Never
simplified_paragraphs: 从前，有个人养了很多羊。一天早上他准备出去放羊，发现少了一只。原来羊圈破了个洞，晚上狼从洞里钻进来，把羊叼走了。邻居劝告他说："赶快把羊圈修一修，堵住那个洞吧!"他说："羊已经丢了，还修羊圈干什么呢?"所以，他没有接受邻居的劝告。
第二天早上，他准备出去放羊，发现又少了一只羊。原来狼又从洞里钻进来，把羊叼走了。他很后悔，赶快堵住了那个洞，把羊圈修补得结结实实。从此，他的羊再也没有被狼叼走过。
羊丢了，把羊圈修补好后，其他的羊就不会再丢了；犯了错误，立即改正，就能减少错误和损失。

dì èr tiān zǎo shang， tā zhǔn bèi chū qù fàng yáng， fā xiàn yòu shǎo le yī zhī yáng。 yuán lái láng yòu cóng dòng lǐ zuān jìn lái， bǎ yáng diāo zǒu le。 tā hěn hòu huǐ， gǎn kuài dǔ zhù le nà gè dòng， bǎ yáng juàn xiū bǔ de jiē jiē shí shí。 cóng cǐ， tā de yáng zài yě méi yǒu bèi láng diāo zǒu guo。
yáng diū le， bǎ yáng juàn xiū bǔ hǎo hòu， qí tā de yáng jiù bù huì zài diū le； fàn le cuò wù， lì jí gǎi zhèng， jiù néng jiǎn shǎo cuò wù hé sǔn shī。
english_paragraphs: Once upon a time, a man kept many sheep. One morning, as he was getting ready to take them out to graze, he noticed that one was missing. It turned out there was a hole in the sheep pen. During the night, a wolf had crawled through it and carried off a sheep. His neighbor advised him, “Hurry and fix the pen. Block up that hole!” But the man said, “The sheep is already gone. What’s the point of fixing the pen now?” So he ignored his neighbor’s advice.

The next morning, as he was getting ready to take the sheep out to graze, he found that another one was missing. The wolf had crawled through the hole again and carried off another sheep. He regretted not listening to his neighbor, so he quickly blocked the hole and repaired the pen until it was strong and secure. From then on, no wolf ever carried off another of his sheep.
Even after you lose a sheep, fixing the pen can keep you from losing the rest. In the same way, correcting a mistake right away can prevent further mistakes and losses.
